test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Indian state became the first to establish a Senior Citizens Commission in March 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** became the first Indian state to establish a **Senior Citizens Commission** in **March 2025**.
 
• The commission was set up to address the **issues and challenges faced by senior citizens**, such as **healthcare, social security, and protection of rights.**
 
• This initiative aligns with Kerala's reputation for prioritizing **social welfare and human development.**
 
• The state has consistently ranked high in indices like the **Human Development Index (HDI)** due to its focus on **education, healthcare, and social security.**
 
• The Senior Citizens Commission aims to ensure the implementation of policies under the **Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007.**
 
• Kerala has a significantly high proportion of **elderly population** compared to other states, making this commission a much-needed step.
 
• This initiative is expected to serve as a model for other states in addressing the needs of the elderly population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra**__

 __
 
• **Maharashtra** is known for its initiatives in **industrial growth and infrastructure development**.
 
• The state has implemented various policies for senior citizens, including **old-age pension schemes**, but it has not yet established a Senior Citizens Commission.
 
• Maharashtra is home to several **elderly welfare organizations** working on social security and healthcare for older adults.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat**__
 __
 
• **Gujarat** is recognized for its **economic growth and industrial policies.**
 
• The state offers welfare schemes for the elderly, such as **financial assistance and healthcare programs**, but it does not have a dedicated Senior Citizens Commission.
 
• Gujarat has focused on promoting community-based programs to support the elderly.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu**__
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu** has enacted several policies for elderly welfare, including **healthcare initiatives and pension schemes.**
 
• The state is known for its **robust healthcare infrastructure** that benefits senior citizens.
 
• Although Tamil Nadu has taken significant steps for senior citizens, it does not have a Senior Citizens Commission as of now.
